body: Rick Ross appeared in court, and his lawyer asked the judge to release him because he’s a celebrity — but the judge wasn’t having it. “I have no idea who you are,except there’s somebody here in the court who’s going to be treated fairly just like everybody else” she said, shutting the whole argument down. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
